records.command: git fetch origin; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...HEAD; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | head -25; cat .dip/.gitignore; cat sites/dip-public/.gitignore; cat classic/apps/web/package.json; rg --files .dip | head -35; rg --files classic/apps/web/src | rg 'full-auto|brand|account|projects' | head -75

git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | python3 -c 'import sys,os,collections; p=sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b"\0"); c=collections.Counter(); sizes=[]
for x in p:
 if not x: continue
 s=x.decode(); n=os.lstat(s).st_size; c[s.split("/")[0]]+=1; sizes.append((n,s))
print(c)
for n,s in sorted(sizes,reverse=True)[:25]: print(n,s)'
